intent_type.instructions: Determine if the current user request is continuing the previous context or introducing a new task.

criteria.continuation: Continuing, resuming, following up on, retrying, approving, or asking to proceed with the previous task.
criteria.new_task: Starting a new standalone task, asking a new question, or changing the subject.

domain.instructions: Classify the high-level intent into the most accurate technical discipline.

criteria.code: Direct implementation, writing code, fixing bugs, unit testing, scripting, editing existing codebase.
criteria.architecture: System design, software architecture, technical blueprints, module boundaries, domain design, workflow planning, DDL schemas.
criteria.ux: UI components, styling, CSS, themes, design tokens, UX wireframes.
criteria.review: Code review, PR/MR auditing, diff analysis, Clean Code standards.
criteria.security: Security audits, OWASP vulnerabilities, secret leaks, threat modeling.
criteria.legal: Legal compliance, GDPR, terms of service, IP, licensing.
criteria.finance: Accounting, taxes, IRPF, VAT, deductions, billing rules, financial strategy.
criteria.general: General conversation, chit-chat, greetings, trivial non-technical queries.

effort.instructions: Rate the analytical complexity and reasoning required for this task.

criteria.low: Straightforward changes, direct bugfixes, simple questions, routine tasks.
criteria.high: Complex architectural decisions, major features, subtle bugs, security/legal analysis.
